note: Canonical design tokens, dark only (brand kit decision L: the brand has no light mode). Synced to the brand kit at origin/main (palette A; typography Q, R, AA3, X4). scripts/gen-tokens.py generates assets/css/tokens.css from this file; scripts/check-contrast.py checks the result. Colors are 6-digit hex so the checker can read them.

groups.comment: Color: dark only (kit decision L). Palette from the brand kit (decision A): amber #FBB03B, ground #0F0F0F (bg), charcoal #202020 (surface), gray #808080. Text colors that fail 4.5:1 on the ground stay site-local.
Redesign surfaces: carbon and plate (dark only). --accent-deep: decoration, never text.
Code highlighting, drawn on --surface (the code-block background).
Effects: amber glow. Alpha values, so they are not contrast-checked.

Type. font-display is for the logo, wordmark and display uses ONLY (kit decisions Q, R, X4), never body text. TODO: the Cyber City font file is NOT bundled (license document not seen in this repo); until a reviewed file is added to static/fonts and approved-assets.txt, the stack falls through to Orbitron (self-hosted, kit decision X1), then Jost. Body is Jost.

tokens.font-display: "Cyber City", Orbitron, Jost, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
